claim_boundary: Solver-policy stage diagnostic on a private fully pinned planted input only. The input supplies five exact factor masks and all five raw factor points, so SAT success does not estimate natural relation yield. No complete target DLP or rho comparison.
promotion_gate: First test large_gauss on the fully pinned N83 five-point control. If no verified model, test persistent_gauss on exactly the same XCNF and cap. Advance a solver policy to pinned-mask and public-only ordinary queries only after a full CNF/XOR model, independent group replay, and checked Sage PASS. A bounded unknown is not a correctness failure or search success.
